_comment: Ratchet baselines for check_skill_graph_drift.py. max_dangling_bugs is the count of genuine broken Skill(plugin:name) references (the 'bugs' category from skill_graph.py, excluding external cross-marketplace refs and template placeholders). max_uncalled_libraries is the count of library-role skills with no inbound Skill() consumer (the AP-3 risk that shared-utility-consumer-rule.md targets). Lower either number whenever you fix refs or wire a consumer to lock in the win. The guard fails if a live count exceeds its baseline. A new library skill legitimately starts uncalled, so raising max_uncalled_libraries records the grace period the rule grants.
